reasoning_content: Let me check the environment further - user IDs, docker daemon availability, internet access.

action.command: cd /workspace && id && echo "USER_ID=$USER_ID GROUP_ID=$GROUP_ID" && echo "---docker info---" && docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}' 2>&1 | head -5 && echo "---compose config---" && docker compose config 2>&1 | head -20 && echo "---internet---" && (curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/ --max-time 10 || echo "no internet")

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && id && echo \"USER_ID=$USER_ID GROUP_ID=$GROUP_ID\" && echo \"---docker info---\" && docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}' 2>&1 | head -5 && echo \"---compose config---\" && docker compose config 2>&1 | head -20 && echo \"---internet---\" && (curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/ --max-time 10 || echo \"no internet\")", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Check user, docker daemon, internet"}
